title: Sekelani i-My Quiet Bible
description: I-My Quiet Bible ingeyamahala kubo bonke, kuze kube nininini. Nxa iyalisiza, lingasiza ukuthi isibane sihlale sibasekile.
sub: Mahala kubo bonke, kuze kube nininini. Nxa iyalisiza, lingasiza ukuthi isibane sihlale sibasekile.
kofiSub: Kanye, kumbe nyanga zonke. Ngekhadi, Apple Pay kumbe Google Pay, akudingeki ukubhalisa.
leave: Kuvuleka ekhasini elitsha. Buyelani lapha, kumbe eBhayibhilini, nxa seliqedile.
btcSub: On-chain kumbe Lightning, ngqo kuseva yethu, kungela muntu ophakathi kumbe omunye.
where:
• Amaseva agcina ukuvumelanisa lamaqembu esebenza.
  • Amabizo esizinda, ukuze i-myquietbible.com iqhubeke isebenza.
  • I-imeyili ethumela amakhodi okungena.
never: Akulalutho eBhayibhilini oluzake luvalwe. Ukupha kuyikubonga, hatshi ithikithi lokungena, njalo akulalutho oluguqukayo ku-app lingapha kumbe lingaphi.
tax: I-My Quiet Bible kayisiyo inhlangano yosizo ebhalisiweyo, ngakho izipho kazinciphisi intela yenu.
other:
